title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah meets revered saint of Pejawar Mutt, Sri Vishwaprasanna Teerth Swami Ji in New Delhi today
subtitle:
Union Home Minister says profoundly fortunate to have met the revered saint of Pejawar Mutt, Sri Vishwaprasanna Teerth Swami Ji, and sought his blessings during the 39th holy Chaturmasya Vrat in New Delhi
The sacred ritual of Chaturmasya Vrat in our culture introduces us to the highest virtue of renunciation, racticed by our revered ascetics through meditation, restraint and inner awakening
May the inner light of Swami Ji continue to illuminate the path for humanity
body_text:
Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah met revered saint of Pejawar Mutt, Sri Vishwaprasanna Teerth Swami Ji in New Delhi today.
Union Home Minister in a post on ‘X’ platform said “Profoundly fortunate to have met the revered saint of Pejawar Mutt, Sri Vishwaprasanna Teerth Swami Ji, and sought his blessings during the 39 th holy Chaturmasya Vrat in New Delhi. The sacred ritual of Chaturmasya Vrat in our culture introduces us to the highest virtue of renunciation, practiced by our revered ascetics through meditation, restraint and inner awakening. May the inner light of Swami Ji continue to illuminate the path for humanity.”
ದೆಹಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿರುವ ಉಡುಪಿಯ ಪೇಜಾವರ ಮಠದ ಪರಮಪೂಜ್ಯ ಶ್ರೀ ವಿಶ್ವಪ್ರಸನ್ನ ತೀರ್ಥ ಸ್ವಾಮೀಜಿಯವರ 39ನೇ ಪವಿತ್ರ ಚಾತುರ್ಮಾಸ್ಯ ವ್ರತದ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವರನ್ನು ಭೇಟಿಯಾಗಿ, ಆಶೀರ್ವಾದವನ್ನು ಪಡೆದುಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದು ನನ್ನ ಸೌಭಾಗ್ಯ. ನಮ್ಮ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಚಾತುರ್ಮಾಸ್ಯ ವ್ರತವು ಪವಿತ್ರ ಆಚರಣೆಯಾಗಿದ್ದು, ನಮ್ಮ ಪೂಜ್ಯ ಸನ್ಯಾಸಿಗಳು ಧ್ಯಾನ,… pic.twitter.com/cMqi3Nph5N — Amit Shah (@AmitShah) September 21, 2026
